charger_nominal_setting.limit: Nominal resistor settings only; not pack, NTC, thermal or input-protection acceptance.

findings.finding: No independent modem undervoltage control or guaranteed 3.0 V margin.
findings.limit: Not a measured failure. Nominal BUVLO and assumed copper are not guaranteed limits; IC, ferrite, contacts, cell and transients are excluded.

findings.finding: VIO LDO enable is tied to VSYS; there is no controlled GPIO supply sequence.
findings.limit: Ideal RC and separate datasheet load conditions do not simulate this board. Nordic permits undefined GPIO states only when the application tolerates them; that review is not complete.

findings.finding: The battery ADC divider remains connected when the GPIO supply is absent.
findings.limit: A backfeed path requiring review, not a demonstrated damage or measured leakage claim. Actual clamp voltage and rail state are unknown.

scope: Frozen r04i topology, source checks and illustrative calculations; no circuit repair.
